title: Emergent narrative roleplaying game - using AI NPCs.
author: NoAutoPilotYT

comments.author: NoAutoPilotYT
comments.body: Just wanted to share a short video, that one of our co-founders put together, showing the progress of our AI /NPC game. Let me know what you think!

comments.author: wzol
comments.body: Very impressive. Maybe adding some predefined lines for the character would make it more fluid? I believe even those can be situation based AI lines - and the flow would be similar like a live role playing game - default options, but you can try anything else too. Anyway, even without AI I'd wishlist it just because of the art style :)

comments.author: BlobbyMcBlobber
comments.body: This doesn't actually look that great to me. It's like automating your content. I rather have a conversation with a character that's deliberate, if that makes sense.

replies.author: afriday11
replies.body:
I think it depends if the game or conversation is well motivated. Talking to an ungrounded LLM about random stuff will be boring.

But well motivated characters could generate interesting and meaningful replies.

replies.author: ncoder
replies.body: The characters will be motivated. The exact words they say will be modulated by the context and what the player says. And we're hoping the merger between the two will create something both compelling, and where your actions or words matter.
